resources.string: Extras most keyboards never had, on or off as one thing

These are the features most people never expect a keyboard to have. Which ones start on depends on the kind of keyboard you picked when you set it up: none for Keep it simple, the ones that need no setup for A good middle, and all of them for Show me everything. Off means gone: no tool, no button on the keyboard, no search result, no background work. Switch one back on and it returns with the settings it had.
Show this feature everywhere and let it work in the background

Turns this group of features on. Its tools, settings and pages show across the app, and any background work it needs can run. With this off, everything in the group is hidden and does nothing, and your settings for it are kept.
